input.command:
while true; do
  status=$(ssh westd-29022 "ls /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/results/humaneval_sft_cka_only_20_1p5b_2048.json.done 2>/dev/null && echo DONE || (ps -p 95945 -o etime= 2>/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo PROCESS_GONE)")
  if echo "$status" | grep -q "DONE"; then
    echo "1.5B CKA-only eval COMPLETED (.done sentinel found). cuda:1 is free."
    break
  elif echo "$status" | grep -q "PROCESS_GONE"; then
    echo "PID 95945 is gone (process ended or crashed). cuda:1 should be free. Check results."
    break
  else
    elapsed=$(echo "$status" | head -1)
    echo "Still running, elapsed: $elapsed"
  fi
  sleep 30
done
